text.title: HealthTech FHIR BA Pack — Output Contract
text.summary: The pack is one JSON document with eight sections, one per rule in 01-core-rules.xml: the element-to-FHIR mapping with terminology bindings, the per-boundary PHI flow table with a named de-identification method for analytics and model flows, the processor list with BAA / Art. 28 status, the HIPAA-GDPR overlap matrix with its five mandatory rows, the FHIR Consent model with IRB reference, the append-only six-year audit trail, and the encryption inventory per store and hop. Subagent MUST satisfy this contract before returning to caller.

required.field: the clinical feature the pack covers
hipaa / gdpr / nhs booleans; both hipaa and gdpr true makes overlap_matrix mandatory (r-hipaa-gdpr-overlap-matrix-minimum-rows)
R4 | R5 — stated once for the whole map (r-clinical-elements-map-to-fhir-resources)
the implementation guide in force: US Core, UK Core, or the customer's named profile

every clinical element read or written: resource, element_path, coded flag; coded elements carry a binding with code_system and system_uri (r-clinical-elements-map-to-fhir-resources, r-coded-terminology-bindings)

one row per boundary a record crosses: from, to, phi_elements[], purpose, de_identification; analytics and model-training flows must be safe-harbor or expert-determination with the method named (r-phi-minimum-necessary-per-flow)
every third party touching PHI: baa_signed with date, dpa_art28_signed where GDPR applies, status cleared or blocking (r-baa-or-dpa-per-processor)

required when regimes.hipaa and regimes.gdpr are both true: lawful_basis, breach_notification_clock, individual_access, retention_and_deletion, cross_border_transfer rows, each naming the stricter clock honoured (r-hipaa-gdpr-overlap-matrix-minimum-rows)

records[] as FHIR Consent (or equivalent) with scope, provision, period, text_version, capture timestamp and channel; treatment and research separate; irb block with protocol number, approval date and waiver flag when research_use (r-consent-as-fhir-consent-with-irb-reference)
model, all six fields, append_only true, retention_years at least 6, per_patient_query true (r-audit-trail-append-only-six-years)
stores[] with encrypted_at_rest and key_management_separated, hops[] with tls_min 1.2 or 1.3; an unencrypted store is status blocking (r-phi-encrypted-transit-and-rest)
every processor without an agreement, every unencrypted store, every identified-PHI analytics flow; empty when none

forbidden.pattern: a clinical element with no resource and element_path, or a resource of "custom" / "json-blob" (fm-clinical-data-in-custom-json)
element_map[] entry with coded true and no binding, or binding.code_system "local" (fm-free-text-in-coded-fields)
processors[] entry with phi_in_scope true, baa_signed false and status cleared; or agreement evidence that is the vendor's compliance page (fm-vendor-without-baa)
a data_flows[] row with purpose analytics or model-training and de_identification none, or safe-harbor without the 18-identifier method named
consent.records[] with one record whose kind is "treatment-and-research", or research_use true with no irb block (fm-single-consent-for-care-and-research)
audit_trail.append_only false, retention_years under 6, per_patient_query false, or fewer than the six fields (fm-mutable-or-short-audit-log)
regimes.hipaa and regimes.gdpr both true with a missing overlap_matrix row or a row without stricter_clock_honoured (fm-regime-clocks-conflated)
encryption.stores[] entry with encrypted_at_rest false and status cleared, or a hop with tls_min below 1.2

allowed-transformations.transformation: Collapse elements that share resource, element_path prefix and binding (e.g. a vitals panel) into one element_map row whose clinical_element lists the members.
Where a processor holds only de-identified data, record phi_in_scope false and cite the de-identification row in data_flows instead of a BAA.
Move a store or processor that cannot be fixed before launch into blocking_findings rather than marking it cleared.

list.item: Every clinical element has a FHIR resource and element_path against the stated fhir_version and profile; every coded element carries a standard code system and its URI.
Every boundary a record crosses has a data_flows row; analytics and model-training rows are safe-harbor or expert-determination with the method named.
Every processor with phi_in_scope true is baa_signed with a date and evidence, or is status blocking and echoed in blocking_findings.
When hipaa and gdpr are both true the overlap_matrix has all five rows and each names the stricter clock honoured.
Treatment and research consent are separate records with text_version, period and capture; research_use true carries the IRB protocol number and approval date.
audit_trail has all six fields, append_only true, retention_years at least 6 and per_patient_query true.
Every store, including backups, indexes and logs, is encrypted at rest with key management separated, or is status blocking; every hop is TLS 1.2 or higher.
